## Actual execution audit

**Provenance key.** Paths below are relative to `/srv/lab-disks/disk2/users/xymo/Documents/Codex/2026-11-02/scene-rsi-rsi-1-3d-blender/`. Expanded smoke files are under `outputs/scene_rsi_pilot/smoke/`; their archive is `work/scene_archive/bundles/smoke.tar.gz`, with member `experiments/scene_rsi_pilot/smoke/` plus the cited relative smoke path. Incident files are under `outputs/scene_rsi_pilot/service_incident_01/retired/`; their archive is `work/scene_archive/bundles/history--service_incident_01.tar.gz`, with member `experiments/scene_rsi_pilot/service_incident_01/retired/` plus the cited relative incident path.

### Smoke 01: completed kitchen, not verified fidelity

The selected step-3 code constructs a corner kitchen from separately included boxes, rods and a swept tube: cabinet carcasses, doors and pulls; two window assemblies; and a countertop with subtracted openings, a compressed rounded sink rim, two subtracted bowls, drains and faucet parts. These are **code representations and intended relationships**, not proof that the parts physically contact or match the photograph [X1470, `smoke_01/steps/003/build.py`, lines 19–57, 74–149].

After realization, the code assigns procedural noise-and-ramp timber using generated coordinates, metallic chrome, emissive window surfaces and a noise-and-ramp countertop; it does not show image-texture loading. It specifies camera `(3.05,-4.05,2.20)` toward `(.85,-.75,1.35)`, 44 mm lens, three area lights, a world background, 256×171 Cycles and 48 samples [X1470, lines 151–241]. **Actual render metadata differs:** the successful Blender log reports 16/16 samples, saves `final.png` and `scene.blend`, and returns `ok: true`; the supplied evidence does not establish why the sample count changed [X1471, `smoke_01/steps/003/result.json`, lines 2–7].

Step 1 failed because its sink-rim fillet exceeded half the smallest dimension; step 2 corrected that construction but failed when the world was `None`. Step 3 creates a world if necessary [X1467, `smoke_01/steps/001/result.json`, lines 2–7; X1469, `smoke_01/steps/002/result.json`, lines 2–7; X1470, lines 222–231]. Step 3 was selected [X1464, `smoke_01/selected.json`, line 2]. The non-formal record reports valid output, SSIM 0.285 and overall 0.528; material and composite checks passed, but structure and functional checks failed for the curved faucet. Semantic completeness and support/collision truth were not measured [X1463, `smoke_01/record.json`, lines 14–25, 36–45]. No image was supplied for visual inspection, so completion and these metrics do not establish visual fidelity.

### Smoke 02: intended reading corner, no completed reconstruction

The final attempted code represents an upholstered chair as a multipart asset with rounded cushions, arms and legs; separately assembled books, hat, throw, rug ornaments and corrugated curtain meshes. Its procedural upholstery uses distorted ring-wave color ramps and noise bump; camera, two lights, 170×256 Cycles, 48 samples and AgX are specified in code [X1479, `smoke_02/steps/003/build.py`, lines 18–32, 48–119, 121–174, 176–209, 241–260]. The intended placements do not verify contact or visual quality.

Step 1 failed on an oversized arm-front fillet; step 2 failed on a missing world; step 3 timed out after approximately 526 seconds and reported no image [X1476, `smoke_02/steps/001/result.json`, lines 2–7; X1478, `smoke_02/steps/002/result.json`, lines 2–7; X1480, `smoke_02/steps/003/result.json`, lines 2–7]. The record reports three executions, invalid output and missing `scene.blend` or `final.png`; its null quality scores are not poor-render scores [X1473, `smoke_02/record.json`, lines 14–35].

### Incident records and validation limits

The retired incident examples show a different failure: student CLI exit 1 during `runtime.ask`, zero executions and missing required artifacts, classified as unresolved CLI/service/process failure—not a demonstrated Blender geometry or rendering error [X1402, `results/r1/sceneevolve_cli/C1/test/commons_155212263/record.json`, lines 16–24, 36–50]. A selected r2 generic H0 record explicitly reuses a failed fixed baseline, with zero new calls or executions; `selected: true` is not acceptance of a valid reconstruction [X1436, `results/r2/generic_rsi/H0/test/commons_155212263/record.json`, lines 16–24, 35–50, 60–68].

The text-editor checker’s positive and negative camera controls returned expected outcomes, but were non-formal mechanical controls with no model calls, not evidence of instruction-editing ability [X1482, `text_editor_checker/status.json`, lines 2–29]. No numeric acceptance or independently assessed visual quality is established in these supplied records.
